item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence of a live crisis in which Xi clearly de-escalated, a new or renewed hotline / communication channel, a public confidence-building measure with Taiwan, the US, or another nuclear-armed state, or an operational accident-prevention mechanism beyond declaratory policy. So the record is rhetorically de-escalatory, operationally unproven.","evidence":[{"title":"China's nuclear policy remains stable, consistent and predictable: spokesperson","publisher":"PRC Ministry of National Defense","date":"2024-09-26","url":"https://eng.mod.gov.cn/xb/News_213114/NewsRelease/16341310.html","summary":"After China’s September ICBM launch, the spokesperson said the nuclear policy is stable, consistent, predictable, and based on no-first-use and minimum required capability. This is the clearest 2024 post-event reassurance and fits clearer communication in a tense moment.","question_ids":["1B.8","1B.2","1B.3"]},{"title":"No-first-use of Nuclear Weapons Initiative","publisher":"PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"2024-07-23","url":"https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/wjb/zzjg_663340/jks_665232/kjfywj_665252/202407/t20240723_11458632.html","summary":"Official paper says Xi re-affirmed that nuclear weapons cannot be used and nuclear war must not be fought, and reiterates no-first-use. This supports crisis de-escalation language.","question_ids":["1B.8","1B.1","1B.2"]},{"title":"PLA conducts joint military drills surrounding Taiwan Island","publisher":"PRC Ministry of National Defense / Xinhua","date":"2024-05-23","url":"https://eng.mod.gov.cn/xb/News_213114/TopStories/16310652.html","summary":"The PLA announced combat-readiness patrols, precision strikes, and a “stern warning” to Taiwan independence forces.
